MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME

Controls & the little details.

Keyboard

Move
Arrow keys
A / B
X / Z
Start / Select
Enter / Shift
Turbo A / B
S / A
Pause / Fullscreen / Mute
P / F / M

Player two

Use a second gamepad, or the number pad: 8 / 2 / 4 / 6 to move, 7 for A, 9 for B, 1 for Start, and 3 for Select. Turn Num Lock on.

Gamepads & touch

Standard controllers: D-pad or left stick to move, bottom face button for A, left face button for B. The menu buttons are Start and Select. Press any button to connect.

On a phone or tablet, turn on touch controls below the screen. Landscape gives you more room.

Cartridges & saves

Open uncompressed .nes files you’re authorized to use. ROMs and save data stay in this browser. No commercial games are included. Some mappers and NES 2.0 cartridges are not supported.

Save slots capture the whole game. Battery saves are kept automatically. Export states before clearing browser site data.

Included demo: Star Circuit

An original NES game. Fly with the arrows, collect gold stars, and hold A (X) to boost. The counter rolls over at 10.

Emulation: JSNES 2.1.0 · Apache 2.0 license. Interface and original demo by Drew Wichman. Not affiliated with Nintendo.
